title: The Painted Skin
synopsis: Chen Wen’s husband Wang Sheng is getting himself into a lot of trouble.

fullText.simplified:
王生知道只有那个道士能救他。他跑去找道士，找了很久，终于找到了。他拉着道士的手说：“我错了！请救救我吧！我不想死啊！”
    道士点点头说：“知道错就好！你放心吧，我帮你让那妖怪离开。这东西很可怜，我也不想杀它。你把这个镜子拿回家，挂在门上，它就不敢来找你了。如果有什么事，你再来找我。我就住在城南的红色小房里。”
    王生谢过道士，跑回家去。一到家，他就把镜子挂在了家门前。
    到了晚上十一点，突然，门外有声音。王生吓得不敢出来，让妻子陈文去看看发生了什么事情。
    陈文偷偷往外看，只见门外有一个全身都是毛的长毛妖怪，张着大嘴，正在向他们家走来。走到门口，抬头看到挂在门上的镜子，又停了下来，没敢再往前走。它在王生家门前走来走去，最后离开了。
    陈文把看到的事情告诉王生，让他可以放心睡觉了。谁知，不一会儿，那个长毛妖怪又回来了。它大声骂道：“臭道士，想要吓我？没门！我花了那么长时间，终于让他身上有了我的味道，可以在今天吃他的心了。现在你要我不吃，怎么可能？他的那颗心，我今天一定要吃到！”说完，那妖怪把门上的镜子扔在地上，走进了王生的房间，把王生的心拿了出来，吃掉了。
    陈文一进房间，就看到丈夫躺在地上，心已经被吃掉了。她吓得坐在王生身边，大哭起来。王生拉住她，说：“快，快去找道士！他住在城南的红色小房里。”话刚说完，王生就死了。
    陈文哭得站都站不起来了，她让下人去叫王生的弟弟王二过来。
    王二的家就在王生家旁边，他一听说哥哥死了，马上就跑来了。
    陈文拉住王二的手，说：“你哥哥被妖怪杀死了！快！快去城南，找一个道士！他住在一个红色小房里。”
    王二跑去找道士，但道士不在家。他在道士家门口等了一个晚上，第二天早上，才看到道士回来。
    王二把昨晚发生的事情告诉了道士。道士听后，很生气：“什么？它竟然敢把我的镜子扔了？这个死妖怪！我本来可怜它，不想杀它。没想到，它竟然敢把镜子扔了，把人杀了？你现在就带我去王生家看看。”
    王二和道士来到王生家。陈文还是坐在地上，和昨天晚上一样。这个道士在王生家看了一下，然后说道：“还好，那妖怪没有走远。王生家旁边是谁的家？”
    王二说：“是我的家。”
    “妖怪现在在你家。”道士说。
fullText.traditional:
王生知道只有那個道士能救他。他跑去找道士，找了很久，終於找到了。他拉著道士的手說：“我錯了！請救救我吧！我不想死啊！”
    道士點點頭說：“知道錯就好！你放心吧，我幫你讓那妖怪離開。這東西很可憐，我也不想殺它。你把這個鏡子拿回家，掛在門上，它就不敢來找你了。如果有什麼事，你再來找我。我就住在城南的紅色小房裡。”
    王生謝過道士，跑回家去。一到家，他就把鏡子掛在了家門前。
    到了晚上十一點，突然，門外有聲音。王生嚇得不敢出來，讓妻子陳文去看看發生了什麼事情。
    陳文偷偷往外看，只見門外有一個全身都是毛的長毛妖怪，張著大嘴，正在向他們家走來。走到門口，抬頭看到掛在門上的鏡子，又停了下來，沒敢再往前走。它在王生家門前走來走去，最後離開了。
    陳文把看到的事情告訴王生，讓他可以放心睡覺了。誰知，不一會兒，那個長毛妖怪又回來了。它大聲罵道：“臭道士，想要嚇我？沒門！我花了那麼長時間，終於讓他身上有了我的味道，可以在今天吃他的心了。現在你要我不吃，怎麼可能？他的那顆心，我今天一定要吃到！”說完，那妖怪把門上的鏡子扔在地上，走進了王生的房間，把王生的心拿了出來，吃掉了。
    陳文一進房間，就看到丈夫躺在地上，心已經被吃掉了。她嚇得坐在王生身邊，大哭起來。王生拉住她，說：“快，快去找道士！他住在城南的紅色小房裡。”話剛說完，王生就死了。
    陳文哭得站都站不起來了，她讓下人去叫王生的弟弟王二過來。
    王二的家就在王生家旁邊，他一聽說哥哥死了，馬上就跑來了。
    陳文拉住王二的手，說：“你哥哥被妖怪殺死了！快！快去城南，找一個道士！他住在一個紅色小房裡。”
    王二跑去找道士，但道士不在家。他在道士家門口等了一個晚上，第二天早上，才看到道士回來。
    王二把昨晚發生的事情告訴了道士。道士聽後，很生氣：“什麼？它竟然敢把我的鏡子扔了？這個死妖怪！我本來可憐它，不想殺它。沒想到，它竟然敢把鏡子扔了，把人殺了？你現在就帶我去王生家看看。”
    王二和道士來到王生家。陳文還是坐在地上，和昨天晚上一樣。這個道士在王生家看了一下，然後說道：“還好，那妖怪沒有走遠。王生家旁邊是誰的家？”
    王二說：“是我的家。”
    “妖怪現在在你家。”道士說。

sentences.traditional: “什麼？它竟然敢把我的鏡子扔了？這個死妖怪！
sentences.pinyin: shén me tā jìng rán gǎn bǎ wǒ de jìng zi rēng le zhè ge sǐ yāo guài
sentences.english: “What? It actually dared to throw away my mirror? This damned demon!

sentences.simplified: 我本来可怜它，不想杀它。
sentences.traditional: 我本來可憐它，不想殺它。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ běn lái kě lián tā bù xiǎng shā tā
sentences.english: I felt sorry for it at first, and didn’t want to kill it.

sentences.simplified: 没想到，它竟然敢把镜子扔了，把人杀了？
sentences.traditional: 沒想到，它竟然敢把鏡子扔了，把人殺了？
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào tā jìng rán gǎn bǎ jìng zi rēng le bǎ rén shā le
sentences.english: Who would have thought that it would actually dare to throw away my mirror and kill him?

sentences.simplified: 你现在就带我去王生家看看。”
sentences.traditional: 你現在就帶我去王生家看看。”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ xiàn zài jiù dài wǒ qù wáng shēng jiā kàn kan
sentences.english: Take me to Wang Sheng’s house right now so I can have a look.”

sentences.simplified: 王二和道士来到王生家。
sentences.traditional: 王二和道士來到王生家。
sentences.pinyin: wáng èr hé dào shì lái dào wáng shēng jiā
sentences.english: Wang Er and the Daoist priest came to Wang Sheng’s house.

sentences.simplified: 陈文还是坐在地上，和昨天晚上一样。
sentences.traditional: 陳文還是坐在地上，和昨天晚上一樣。
sentences.pinyin: chén wén hái shì zuò zài dì shang hé zuó tiān wǎn shang yí yàng
sentences.english: Chen Wen was still sitting on the floor, the same way as last night.

sentences.simplified: 这个道士在王生家看了一下，然后说道：
sentences.traditional: 這個道士在王生家看了一下，然後說道：
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dào shì zài wáng shēng jiā kàn le yí xià rán hòu shuō dào
sentences.english: This Daoist priest looked around Wang Sheng’s house for a while, and then said, ..

sentences.simplified: “还好，那妖怪没有走远。王生家旁边是谁的家？”
sentences.traditional: “還好，那妖怪沒有走遠。王生家旁邊是誰的家？”
sentences.pinyin: hái hǎo nà yāo guài méi yǒu zǒu yuǎn wáng shēng jiā páng biān shì shéi de jiā
sentences.english: .. “Fortunately, the demon didn’t go far. Whose house is next to Wang Sheng’s?”

sentences.simplified: 王二说：“是我的家。”
sentences.traditional: 王二說：“是我的家。”
sentences.pinyin: wáng èr shuō shì wǒ de jiā
sentences.english: Wang Er said, “That’s my house.”

sentences.simplified: “妖怪现在在你家。”道士说。
sentences.traditional: “妖怪現在在你家。”道士說。
sentences.pinyin: yāo guài xiàn zài zài nǐ jiā dào shì shuō
sentences.english: “The demon is in your house now,” said the Daoist priest.

sentence_translations: Wang Sheng knew that only the Daoist priest could save him.
He ran to look for the Daoist priest. He looked for a long time, and finally found him.
He pulled at the Daoist priest’s hand and said, “I was wrong! Please save me! I don’t want to die!”
The Daoist priest nodded and said, “It’s good that you realized that you were wrong!
Don’t you worry, I’ll help you make that demon leave. It is a very pitiful thing, I don’t want to kill it either.
Take this mirror home with you, hang it on your door, and it won’t dare come looking for you.
If anything happens, come and see me again. I live in a small red house in the south part of town.”
Wang Sheng thanked the Daoist priest and rushed back home.
As soon as he got home, he hung the mirror on the front of the door.
At 11 pm that night, suddenly, there was a sound outside the door.
Wang Sheng was so scared that he didn’t dare go outside, and had his wife Chen Wen go see what had happened.
Chen Wen covertly looked outside, only to see a long-haired demon with a body covered with hair was outside the door.
It was coming towards their house with its mouth wide open.
It walked to the door, raised its head and saw the mirror hanging on the door.
It stopped, and didn’t dare come any closer.
It walked around in front of Wang Sheng’s house, and finally left.
Chen Wen told Wang Sheng what she had seen to let him ease his worries and fall asleep.
Who would have thought that long-haired demon would soon come back.
It cursed loudly, “Loathsome Daoist priest! Does he want to scare me? No way!
I’ve spent so much time, and finally made him smell like me so I can eat his heart today.
Now you don’t want me to eat it. How is that possible? I will definitely eat it today!”
When it had finished speaking, the demon took the mirror on the door and threw it to the ground.
It walked into Wang Sheng’s room, took out Wang Sheng’s heart, and ate it up.
As soon as Chen Wen entered the room, she saw her husband lying on the floor, his heart already eaten away.
She was so scared that she sat down next to Wang Sheng and started crying loudly.
Wang Sheng pulled at her and said: “Quick, go find the Daoist priest!
He lives in a small red house in the south part of town.” As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Sheng died.
Chen Wen was crying so hard that she couldn’t even stand up.
She had a servant go ask Wang Sheng’s younger brother Wang Er to come.
Wang Er’s house was right next to Wang Sheng’s house.
As soon as he heard that his older brother had died, he immediately ran over.
Chen Wen pulled at Wang Er’s hand and said, “Your older brother was killed by a demon! Quick!
Quickly go to the south part of town, and look for a Daoist priest! He lives in a small red house.”
Wang Er rushed out looking for the Daoist priest, but the Daoist priest wasn’t at home.
He waited at the door to the Daoist priest’s house overnight.
He didn’t see the Daoist priest come back until early the next morning.
Wang Er told the Daoist priest what had happened last night. The Daoist priest got very angry when he heard that.
“What? It actually dared to throw away my mirror? This damned demon!
I felt sorry for it at first, and didn’t want to kill it.
Who would have thought that it would actually dare to throw away my mirror and kill him?
Take me to Wang Sheng’s house right now so I can have a look.”
Wang Er and the Daoist priest came to Wang Sheng’s house.
Chen Wen was still sitting on the floor, the same way as last night.
This Daoist priest looked around Wang Sheng’s house for a while, and then said, ..
.. “Fortunately, the demon didn’t go far. Whose house is next to Wang Sheng’s?”
Wang Er said, “That’s my house.”
“The demon is in your house now,” said the Daoist priest.
